_about: Each institute's head-office point (decision 5): "site" — the map pin on the institute's own site, inside the district its address names; "osm" — the OpenStreetMap element that names the institute itself, from Geofabrik's extract of 2026-10-01 (tools/sources.json, osmGeofabrikBangladesh; ODbL), its point inside the outline, the outline pinned by SHA-256 of its rounded coordinates; "approximate" — the COD-AB capital of its district (tools/sources.json, codAbBangladesh), marked. Every point lies in its district (the shared district file).
